items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] This wasn't when Jimmy Rushing was with -- [INTERVIEWEE] No, Jimmy wasn't --

ctx.x: cause first thing he had -- he auditioned me. He and Hank Jones, they auditioned me somwhere on the East Side, and he set back there in his chair and I just whatever I wanted to play, Hank played it with me and he listened. And he says okay. He liked me. So, I went out on gigs with him. Jobs with him. I went to Brussels with him. At the fair, I guess it was -- the festival.
This wasn't when Jimmy Rushing was with --
